consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer reading avatar.carried_items[] and asking 'which carried item occupies the wielded slot and which fills each worn slot' to lay the doll out.
scope: only the character's own carried items (the avatar's wielded + worn collections), not nearby ground-tile items and not a possession predicate over reachable inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates the avatar's wielded_items(), worn, and inventory and emits each item's raw identity (type_id/name/symbol/charges) tagged with a 'wielded'|'worn'|'inventory' location label, i.e. authoritative per-slot carried state, not a computed/filtered display verdict.
divergence: An item lying on the avatar's own tile (present in map::i_at via write_entities, Excerpt 2) but not actually worn or wielded: a correct paperdoll must leave the worn/wielded slots showing only ctx.u.worn / wielded_items(); an answer sourced from the ground-item stack would falsely populate a slot with that loose ground item.
